name.value: Twin Lakes Golf Course & RV Park

description.value: Twin Lakes is a 285-acre golf resort nestled in a scenic valley surrounded by rock cliffs near Kaleden, BC, offering 76 full-hookup RV sites alongside an 18-hole golf course. The clubhouse features a concession/snack shack with local wines and micro-brewed beers and an outdoor patio overlooking the course. Touring cyclists will find hiking and biking trails, sandy beaches, and over twenty local wineries all within a 20-minute ride.
